SUPPLY AGREEMENT

Agreement No. FHR-2026-07

Synthetic demonstration document, written to match the TermsLedger demo scenario. It is not a real agreement and binds no one.

This Supply Agreement (the "Agreement") is made on 1 September 2026 between:

(1) Lingnan Homeware Manufacturing Co., Ltd., a company registered in Foshan, Guangdong (the "Supplier"); and

(2) Foshan Home Retail Co., a company registered in Foshan, Guangdong (the "Buyer").

The Supplier and the Buyer are each a "Party" and together the "Parties".

1. DEFINITIONS

1.1 "Batch" means one delivery of Products under this Agreement.

1.2 "Products" means the home furnishings described in Schedule 2.

1.3 "Invoice Date" means the date printed on the Supplier's invoice for a Batch.

1.4 "Business Day" means a day other than a Saturday, a Sunday or a public holiday in the People's Republic of China.

2. TERM

2.1 This Agreement takes effect on 1 September 2026 and continues for a term of twelve (12) months, until 31 August 2027.

2.2 Either Party may terminate this Agreement by giving the other Party ninety (90) days' written notice.

3. PRICE

3.1 The Buyer shall pay the Supplier RMB 420,000 (four hundred and twenty thousand yuan) for each Batch.

3.2 The price of a Batch includes delivery to the Buyer's distribution centre and value-added tax.

4. INVOICING AND PAYMENT

4.1 The Supplier shall invoice each Batch on the day it is delivered. Batches are delivered every thirty (30) days, the first regular Batch on 3 October 2026, as set out in Schedule 1.

4.2 Each invoice is payable forty-five (45) days after the Invoice Date.

4.3 The Buyer shall pay by bank transfer to the account of the Supplier stated on the invoice.

4.4 Early settlement. The Buyer may settle any invoice early, within two (2) days of the Supplier's written request, at a discount of 1.2% of the invoice amount.

4.5 Payment of an invoice is subject to the Buyer's receipt of the documents listed in clause 6.

5. DELIVERY

5.1 The Supplier shall deliver each Batch of Products to the Buyer's distribution centre in Shunde, Foshan.

5.2 Each Batch shall conform to the specifications in Schedule 2 and be packed for retail display.

5.3 Title to and risk in a Batch pass to the Buyer on delivery.

6. DOCUMENTS FOR PAYMENT

6.1 The Supplier shall provide the following documents for each Batch:
(a) a delivery note signed by the Buyer's warehouse;
(b) a VAT special invoice (fapiao) for the Batch; and
(c) a quality inspection certificate for the Batch.

7. QUALITY AND RETURNS

7.1 The Buyer may reject any Product that does not conform to Schedule 2 by written notice within ten (10) Business Days of delivery.

7.2 The Supplier shall replace rejected Products at its own cost.

8. CONFIDENTIALITY

8.1 Each Party shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential and shall not disclose them to any third party except its professional advisers, its lenders or as required by law.

9. AMENDMENT

9.1 No amendment to this Agreement is valid unless it is made in writing and signed by both Parties.

10. GOVERNING LAW AND DISPUTES

10.1 This Agreement is governed by the laws of the People's Republic of China.

10.2 Any dispute arising from this Agreement shall be submitted to the people's court with jurisdiction over the place where the Buyer is registered.

11. GENERAL

11.1 This Agreement is the entire agreement between the Parties about its subject matter.

11.2 This Agreement is made in two counterparts, one for each Party, with equal effect.

SCHEDULE 1. DELIVERY AND INVOICING SCHEDULE

1. Opening Batch: delivered and invoiced on 18 September 2026 under invoice RCV-A for RMB 420,000.

2. Regular Batches: one Batch every thirty (30) days from 3 October 2026, each invoiced on its delivery date.

SCHEDULE 2. PRODUCTS AND SPECIFICATIONS

1. Upholstered sofas, dining sets and mattresses in the ranges listed in the Buyer's monthly order.

2. Fabrics and foams must meet national standard GB 17927.1 for furniture flammability.

Signed for and on behalf of the Supplier: Chen Wei, Director. Date: 1 September 2026.

Signed for and on behalf of the Buyer: Li Na, Purchasing Director. Date: 1 September 2026.

REVOLVING CREDIT LINE AGREEMENT

Agreement No. MB-CL-2026-031

Synthetic demonstration document, written to match the TermsLedger demo scenario. It is not a real agreement and binds no one.

This Agreement is made on 25 August 2026 between Pearl River Commercial Bank, Foshan Branch (the "Bank") and Lingnan Homeware Manufacturing Co., Ltd. (the "Borrower").

1. THE FACILITY

1.1 The Bank makes available to the Borrower a revolving working-capital credit line with a facility limit of RMB 150,000.

1.2 The Borrower shall use each drawing for its general working capital.

2. DRAWDOWN

2.1 Drawdowns are funded on the same day as the drawdown request.

2.2 The Borrower may repay and redraw any part of the credit line during its availability.

3. INTEREST AND FEES

3.1 The interest rate is 6.4% per annum, accruing daily on the amount drawn.

3.2 No arrangement fee, commitment fee or other fee is payable for the credit line.

4. REPAYMENT

4.1 Each drawing is repaid in a single bullet payment at the end of its interest period, and may be redrawn.

5. FINANCIAL COVENANTS

5.1 Debt service coverage: the Borrower shall maintain a debt service coverage ratio (DSCR) of at least 1.25 times in each month.

5.2 Leverage: the total debt of the Borrower shall not exceed 2.5 times its annual EBITDA.

5.3 Clean-down: the outstanding balance of the credit line shall be reduced to zero for at least thirty (30) consecutive days in each year.

6. SECURITY

6.1 No personal guarantee, collateral or pledge is required under this Agreement.

7. GOVERNING LAW

7.1 This Agreement is governed by the laws of the People's Republic of China.

Signed for the Bank: Zhou Min, Relationship Manager. Date: 25 August 2026.

Signed for the Borrower: Chen Wei, Director. Date: 25 August 2026.
